title: Gate feedback v1
description: Structured, redacted feedback that gate-warden publishes for one gate run, inside a fenced `json gate-feedback/v1` block in the check run's output.text. gate-warden is the producer; CogWorks and humans are consumers. Consumers must reject unknown major versions and ignore unknown fields, so objects are open to additional properties for minor, additive changes. See docs/spec/interfaces/feedback-format.md.

gate.description: Gate id. G9 is owned by release-ratifier and is never reported by gate-warden.

config_sha.description: Default-branch commit the configuration was read from.

category.description: Why the gate has this outcome. See docs/spec/vocabulary.md#outcome-category.

reason.description: gate-warden-authored explanation, never check output. Required for configuration, infrastructure, superseded and not-evaluated.

checks.description: One entry per declared check, in declared order.

truncated.description: Present only if findings were dropped to fit the output limit.

allOf.description: reason is required whenever the outcome is not a plain verdict or check error.
A passing gate is always a plain verdict.
not-evaluated verdict and category go together.

error_kind.description: Set only when status is error.

summary.description: From the check result, capped and escaped.

why_it_matters.description: The check's purpose from the gate definition (trusted, default branch). Only for non-passing checks.

allowed.description: The check's allowed_responses from the gate definition (trusted, default branch). Only for non-passing checks.

findings.description: Redacted visible findings, sorted by (severity, path, line, rule, message).

holdout_failures.description: REQ-IDs of failing holdouts, deduplicated and sorted. UNSPECIFIED stands for a holdout finding without a req_id. Nothing else is published for holdouts.

allOf.description: error_kind is present if and only if status is error.
Guidance texts are included only for non-passing checks.

finding.description: A visible finding after redaction. Holdout findings never appear here.

path.description: Repository-relative path using forward slashes; no leading slash, no '..' segments.

message.description: Capped at 300 characters (including the … suffix when cut) and escaped.
